ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
